articles.title: Petrol pump UPI payments above Rs 2,000 to stop from October 16 in Madhya Pradesh: Dealers cite 0.4% MDR charge; debit and credit cards to remain available
articles.description: Petrol pump dealers in Madhya Pradesh will stop accepting UPI payments above Rs 2,000 from October 16, citing a proposed 0.4 per cent Merchant Discount Rate (MDR). Fuel retailers say their narrow profit margins make it difficult to absorb the additional cost. Customers can continue to use debit and credit cards for fuel purchases, while the association has urged the government to extend existing MDR exemptions to UPI transactions.

articles.title: This swing state Republican keeps distancing himself from Trump. It may not save him in the midterms
articles.description: It’s hard to imagine a Republican who’s done more to draw a sharp contrast with the president than Brian Fitzpatrick. The Pennsylvania congressman skipped the president’s recent midterm convention. Fitzpatrick voted against Trump's tariffs, Trump's signature tax cut legislation and Trump's ability to wage war against Iran without congressional approval. But Democrats are hopeful that Trump's low approval ratings and rising gas prices will make it impossible for Fitzpatrick to win reelection this year. He's one of the few Republican lawmakers representing districts won by Democrat Kamala Harris in the White House race two years ago.
